verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The wheels on the bus go round and round,
Round and round, round and round.
The wheels on the bus go round and round,

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: The wipers on the bus go swish, swish, swish,
Swish, swish, swish, swish, swish, swish.
The wipers on the bus go swish, swish, swish,

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: The horn on the bus goes beep, beep, beep,
Beep, beep, beep, beep, beep, beep.
The horn on the bus goes beep, beep, beep,

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: The people on the bus go up and down,
Up and down, up and down.
The people on the bus go up and down,

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: The doors on the bus go open and shut, Open and shut, open and shut.
The doors on the bus go open and shut, All through the town.
